Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The assembly was straightforward. I had to retrace a couple of steps but had if figured out fairly quickly. Parts are packed tightly and could be located anywhere. Layout all of the parts and pieces beforehand.
Initial start-up was easy and uneventful. Everything went smoothly and as planned. So far I am pleased with the purchase.
The first couple of uses were mainly trying to figure out how to dial the burners in and hold the temperature steady. I have a moderately windy deck space so I had to move the grill to a more protected area as I could hear the burners struggling in the wind.
The grill isn't that easy to maneuver around. The take-down ledge is instable as a handle to lift the grill and wheel it around. 
I have only used the grill a few times. I am pleased with the performance so far. I wish that I could see the burners to ensure that they are indeed lit as my previous 2-burner grill would often blow out from the wind.
Results.Title: it is a Weber - all the others are just grills.

Results.ReviewText: I really like my new Weber Spirit II E-310 grill and look forward to many years of enjoyment. I have added the Weber iGrill 3 and probes, a Weber grill basket and Weber cover.  I bought the Weber Spirit II E-310 to replace another brand grill that had rusted out and had never cooked evenly.  I am impressed with the Weber Spirit II E-310 solid construction, even heating and easy cleaning.  The Weber iGrill 3 has taken much of the guess work out of my grilling and we have seen an immediate improvement in my results. I purchased my Weber Spirit II E-310 at Home Depot on March 23.  Unfortunately this meant I missed the April sale price and Home Depot would not price match when I went back to ask on April 2.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
